title: Crochet square coaster - free pattern
author: The Lazy Hobbyhopper
notes: Start line 'Make a magic ring.' added (Round 1 itself begins 'make a magic ring', kept as published). Round 2's heading and its note were on separate lines; joined. Two colours alternate: colour B rounds are sc worked into the gaps between dc with ch-2/ch-3 between; colour A rounds skip over them and work into the corner/ch-1 spaces of the previous colour-A round, giving an interlocked lattice. Rnd 7 says 'corner ch-2 space of round 3' (presumably round 5). Rnd 4 and 6 as written put no chain between adjacent groups inside the bracketed repeat; transcribed literally. Materials and video link omitted. Stitch graph: round 5 reads badly (cost 33.3); check where its stitches go.
